The '''Crispin system''' was located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and contained the [[Crispin asteroid field]]. Some time before the start of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], a group of [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] led by [[Canderous Ordo]] discovered an object resembling a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yorik-stronha]] that had been hidden inside an ice asteroid there.

The [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt also served as a hiding place for several bands of anonymous [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]; according to Canderous, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] were there to "play" with them, possibly as a training exercise or for sport.

==Behind the scenes==
There is some debate as to what exactly the object that the Mandalorians encountered in the asteroid field was. While the description matches that of a Yuuzhan Vong coralcraft, some fans argue that it could not have been possible for a Yuuzhan Vong ship to have made it to the galaxy four millennia ahead of the first scouting fleets, despite the confirmed presence of the Yuuzhan Vong's [[slivilith]] in the galaxy during that period.
